palette_source: arcade round-specific index table 0x3BA88+(round-1)*0x20 selects a pool index; palette = pool 0x4FD02 + pool_index*0x20 (FUN_0003ba20/56/64); NOT direct-bank; validated vs KF-1214 bank 0x36 (round-1 pool index 13 @ 0x4FEA2, green Lizardman).

LIZARDMAN.provenance: PROVEN (arcade loader FUN_0003ba20/56/64): effective bank = emitted word0 nibble | colbank 0x30; round-1 index row 0x3BA88 selects pool index 13 at pool 0x4FD02; validated vs KF-1214 bank 0x36 (green Lizardman).
LIZARDMAN.format: 0RGB nibble source -> xBGR555 (5-bit channel = nibble*2, FUN_0003ba64); display RGB8 = MAME pal5bit(nibble*2) = ((n*2)<<3)|((n*2)>>2)
